body.name: Empirical tail and joint-mark calibration
body.construction: With \(t_n=n^{-\beta}\), define \(\widehat T(t)=n^{-1}\sum_iA_i\mathbf1\{\widehat e_i\leq t\}\), \(\widehat\alpha=\log\{\widehat T(2t_n)/\widehat T(t_n)\}/\log2\), \(\widehat K=\widehat T(t_n)/t_n^{\widehat\alpha}\), \(\widehat a_n=(n\widehat K)^{1/\widehat\alpha}\), and \(\widehat H\) as the empirical law of \((Y_i-\widehat\mu_1(X_i),\widehat\mu_1(X_i)-\widehat\mu_0(X_i))\) among \(A_i=1\) and \(\widehat e_i\leq t_n\).
